centralValidation: Enter a name, mass between 10¹⁰ and 10³² {{massUnit}}, and radius between 1 and 10¹⁰ {{distanceUnit}}.
centralUpdated: Central body updated. Position and velocity preserved.
orbitValidation: Enter a name, a valid altitude, inclination 0–180°, and node longitude / phase 0–360°.
name: Name
noCraft: No spacecraft yet. Add one to begin.
equatorialNote: Equatorial orbit · every position lies on the reference plane.
circularDescription: Altitude and velocity stay in sync for a circular orbit.
invalidCircularSpeed: This speed does not produce a circular orbit above the surface.
circularNote: Rebuilds a circular orbit and pauses. Altitude-only edits keep the live orbital plane and phase. Changing the plane or phase resets position to the editor setup. Inclination is measured from XY; +Z is north.
launchNotSaved: This live launch is not part of the saved initial configuration. Use Maneuver after engine cutoff.
emptyOrbit: Add a spacecraft or launch a vehicle to inspect its orbit.
maneuverDescription: Shape your orbit with a change in velocity.
customNote: In-plane: 0° = transverse along motion; 90° = radial out. Out-of-plane: +90° = normal; −90° = anti-normal.
undefinedPlaneNote: Orbital plane is undefined for radial or zero-speed motion. Normal and custom directions are unavailable; use prograde or radial thrust first.
maneuverValidation: Use Δv 0–1,000,000 {{speedUnit}}, duration 0–7,200 {{timeUnit}} (exclusive of zero), in-plane angle ±360°, and out-of-plane angle ±90°.
idealAcceleration: Ideal acceleration: {{value}} {{unit}}. Local direction updates in flight. No fuel consumed.
zeroSpeed: Velocity is zero; using the local tangent as prograde.
selectForManeuver: Select a flying spacecraft and preview your maneuver.
lastManeuver: Last maneuver: integrated {{integrated}} {{unit}}; actual velocity-vector change {{actual}} {{unit}} (includes gravity).
targetDescription: Rotate the orbital plane at the next equatorial crossing while preserving orbital energy and shape. This is an ideal, fuel-free impulse.
targetValidation: Target inclination must be between 0° and 180°.
requirePlane: An orbital plane is required. Use prograde or radial thrust first.
stopForPlane: Stop the engine before planning a plane change.
pendingNote: A plane change is armed. Use the simulation controls to pause or resume, or cancel it below the view before planning another.
equatorialExecute: Equatorial orbit · execute at current position
solverNote: The lowest Δv solution at this node is selected. Normal-only thrust generally changes speed and orbit shape; this maneuver combines velocity components.
locatingNode: Locating the next node and solving the velocity change…
selectForPlane: Select a coasting spacecraft and preview a target between 0° and 180°.
executionNote: Execution advances with simulation time. Pause or cancel at any time. Edits to the central body or this spacecraft cancel the plan.
planeExecuted: Plane change executed at T+ {{time}}. Inclination: {{inclination}}° · Δv: {{deltaV}} {{unit}}.
launchTagline: From the surface to the stars.
headingNote: 0° = local north · 90° = east. Non-rotating surface; zero initial velocity. At a polar site, longitude and azimuth select the launch meridian plane, which guidance keeps.
pitchNote: 90° = vertical · 0° = local horizon. A single continuous burn; no automatic circularization.
launchValidation: Use positive vehicle parameters, burn time ≤ 7,200 {{timeUnit}}, turn end after turn start, pitch / latitude ±90°, longitude ±180°, and azimuth 0–360°.
adjustLaunch: Adjust parameters to calculate a new launch.
toggleReference: Toggle reference plane and north axis
